terms.outcome: Unresolved standoff on principle; live proposal for a sequenced non-closure test with a trigger-based fallback if savings targets are missed.
Unresolved standoff; labour demands an absolute ban while capital retains forced layoffs as a last resort pending quantified gap analysis.
Live proposal range; labour seeks unconditional binding guarantees versus capital and the state preferring conditional, performance-linked commitments.
Agreed to a site-by-site quantified scenario model and a second-stage negotiation focused on the residual economic gap.
